headline: Council approved battery storage deal with Kearsarge Energy, AFSCME contract, and $193,053 police grant 7-2-3
summary: The council took action on consent agenda items including an ADS Environmental Services contract up to $1,100,000, an Intervale Road lease, and airport construction contracts up to $26,500,000. It approved a 20-year battery storage agreement with Kearsarge Energy, ratified the AFSCME labor contract, and approved a $193,053 police grant despite two dissenting votes.
decisions: Approved going into executive session to discuss pending or potential civil litigation.
Adopted the consent agenda, which included contracts, permits, appointments, and resolutions listed in items 6.2 through 6.16.
Approved a 20-year power purchase agreement with Kearsarge Energy for battery storage at the McNeil Generating Station.
Adopted the resolution ratifying the AFSCME collective bargaining agreement for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2028.
Approved accepting a $193,053.00 grant from the Vermont Department of Public Safety for Emergency Response Unit Tactical Supplies, passing 7-2 with 3 absent.
